items.title: Innovations of H.266 in Live Streaming

It balances cost reduction and experience enhancement, providing a no-compromise path for global live platforms to scale ultra-HD streaming efficiently.

items.title: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for Video Quality Enhancement and Super-Resolution in Live Streaming
items.content_text: Tencent Cloud Diffusion Transformer (DiT) live video enhancement is the industry’s first DiT-based AI visual solution deployed in real-time live streaming, launched in February 2026. It breaks the limitations of traditional CNN and GAN models, supporting artifact removal, 120FPS frame interpolation, real-time 4K super-resolution, face/text ROI enhancement and SDR-to-HDR color optimization. Powered by Causal DiT, rolling cache, VAE knowledge distillation and one-step diffusion acceleration, meeting strict low-latency live streaming standards. Integrated with pixel-level and semantic-level LoRA, it supports dynamic multi-scene quality adjustment.

items.title: Smart Erase for Global Distribution of Short Dramas and E-commerce

It enables blurring, mosaicking or seamless removal of logos, hardcoded subtitles, faces and license plates in video frames. Adapted for short dramas, short videos, cross-border e-commerce and independent media studios, it supports subtitle OCR translation, AI dubbing localization and automated batch processing for compliant global content distribution.
